title: How-to list: fix your LinkedIn profile
note: Sample copy written for layout. The figure on the stat slide is a placeholder, not sourced.

slides.headline: Fix your LinkedIn profile in 15 minutes
slides.sub: Three edits that make people stop scrolling and start replying.

slides.headline: Rewrite your headline
slides.body: Skip the job title. Say who you help and how. Something like: I help B2B teams ship onboarding that sticks. Keep it under 120 characters.

slides.headline: Lead your About with a result
slides.body: Open with one number or outcome, not a list of adjectives. Two short paragraphs is plenty. End with how to reach you.

slides.headline: Pin one proof post
slides.body: Feature your best post or case study at the top. People decide in seconds. Give them one thing worth clicking.

slides.headline: Before you hit save
items: Photo is a clear, well-lit headshot
Banner says what you do, not a slogan
Contact info and booking link are current

slides.label: more replies when your headline says who you help
slides.note: Placeholder figure for layout. Use your own data.

slides.headline: Save this and fix it tonight
